output.reason: The brief gives specific, testable evidence: per-version rebuffering on 5.2 TVs is high on every ISP, and pre-launch test TVs on the old CDN showed the same pattern, which separates the app from the CDN. It also offers a cheap, reversible fix and says plainly that the cancellation link is unproven. It loses some points because it never squarely reconciles its "Kestria first" claim with the release digest's "live in all markets on 9 Oct" wording.
